simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to עִלָּה (H5931) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: עִלָּה (ʻillâh) means a pretext (as arising artificially) First listed occurrence: Dan 6 5.

definitions.full: H5931. illah עִלָּה noun feminine matter, affair, occasion (Syriac , see Biblical Hebrew I. עלל ); — absolute ׳ע Dan 6:5 (twice in verse); 6:6 ( = ground of accusation).
